title: Products Lightbox Gallery
description: A large draggable canvas holds a 12x12 grid of sneaker product tiles that the user pans by mouse-dragging, with movement GSAP-tweened (x/y, power1.out) for inertial smoothing. Clicking a tile (drag vs click is disambiguated via mousedown/mousemove flags) fades in a full-screen lightbox modal populated with that product's image, name and info via gsap.to opacity 0 to 1.

images.desc: Two colorful grey/yellow/red technical runners floating against a pale blue-grey studio background ('Court Two — Grey' colorways).
images.role: Product tile in the draggable grid and the lightbox product image (also the default modal image).

images.desc: Pair of all-white knit sneakers shot top-down on a white surface ('Court One — Chalk' colorways).
images.role: Product tile in the draggable grid and a 'Pairs well with' suggestion thumbnail in the lightbox.

images.desc: Pair of light-grey knit trainers with white soles leaning against a soft grey studio background ('Trainer — Fog' colorways).
images.role: Product tile in the draggable grid and lightbox product image.

images.desc: White perforated runner with a bright red collar lining resting on white crumpled fabric ('Runner — White' colorways).
images.role: Product tile in the draggable grid, lightbox product image and a 'Pairs well with' suggestion thumbnail.

images.desc: Toe of an all-black leather sneaker touching down on a clean white studio floor ('Court Low — Ink' colorways).
images.role: Product tile in the draggable grid and lightbox product image.

intent.useWhen: Úsalo para un escaparate de productos explorable: un lienzo enorme que se arrastra con el ratón y un lightbox a pantalla completa al hacer clic en cada producto.
